results.title: The Library
results.overview: JK enters the Library in search of a book but he quickly discovers that his wishes might not be that simple. Halls and corridors multiply like a labyrinth without a way out, stairs lead to impossible places, and the employees of the Library don't offer any help. The Library seems to watch over and guide him against his will. Every attempt to move forward traps him, plunging him further into the chaos of an absurd system. What began as a small desire turns into a mental and sensory odyssey, where JK will even have to resort to violence.  What is your Library?

results.title: Pentimento
results.overview: On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

results.title: Addicted to It
results.overview: Dace attempts the impossible: a peaceful walk without his phone. But his device, Phoney Bunny, springs to life and chases him like a clingy ex. As he recruits fellow screen junkies, one question remains: can you live without your phone?

results.title: Killers of the Flower Moon: A Historic Collaboration
results.original_title: Killers of the Flower Moon: A Historic Collaboration
results.overview: New documentary featuring Scorsese, actors Leonardo DiCaprio and Lily Gladstone, author David Grann, Osage Nation Principal Chief Geoffrey Standing Bear, Osage cultural consultant John Williams, editor Thelma Schoonmaker, and other members of the cast and crew

results.title: Skeleton Man
results.overview: Skater boys are terrorized by a delirious skeleton man at a strip mall pizzeria.

results.title: Spare Time
results.overview: When a local Ten Pin Bowling Alley in the northern suburbs of Melbourne Australia puts on a Pro Amateur competition with the biggest cash prize in the country, the local league players try their luck.

results.title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
results.original_title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
results.overview: DERNSIE is an intimate portrait of Bruce Dern—tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation—whose endurance has shaped both a turbulent life and one of Hollywood’s most enduring careers. A relentless runner on and off screen, Dern has outlasted the very industry that defined him.

results.title: One Last Order
results.overview: A cherished drive-thru worker receives the day's proceeds as her going-away gift when the community queues up to bid her farewell on her last day in Gainesville.

results.title: Fifteen
results.overview: Ligia and Mayte are best friends who are planning the “best quinceañera party ever” in order to achieve the respect and the popularity they so much desire. When a supernatural beast attacks Joel, Ligia’s boyfriend, he manages to escape but he is gradually transforming into something fierce and inexplicable. Ligia will soon discover she is pregnant and the creature that she’s carrying inside is not only a threat to her but to everyone around her.

results.title: JENSEN SPECIAL
results.overview: In this special broadcast, we look back on Robert Jensen's groundbreaking television career through memorable clips from his iconic RTL5 talk show JENSEN.

results.title: Ram and Leela
results.overview: A repeatedly unlucky man finally finds the woman of his dreams, only for an unexpected twist to challenge his understanding of love and commitment.

results.title: Vera
results.overview: A pregnant woman flees a violent past and takes refuge on the coast of Santa Fe, where she struggles to overcome the challenges of nature and existence itself.

results.title: Countdown: Rousey vs. Carano
results.overview: Hit training camp with MMA legends Ronda Rousey and Gina Carano before they return to the cage on May 16 for their must-see fight that’s been years in the making. Countdown: Rousey vs. Carano is narrated by Uma Thurman and directed by Tim Mullen & Jackie Decker.

results.title: Muito Prazer
results.overview: Rubem, a rideshare driver with no prospects, receives as inheritance the Pérola Motel, which he soon discovers is a dilapidated building. There, he meets Grace, a former employee who had stayed on living in one of the suites after the motel closed. Unable to sell the property and mired in debt, Grace and Rubem join forces to reopen the motel. Almost as a lark and with the help of Nalva, an internet whiz, they begin recording their guests and, to make some extra cash, selling the videos with identities masked to erotic websites. The scheme quickly becomes both lucrative and dangerous.

results.title: Columbine Shooting: Minute by Minute
results.overview: A detailed, minute-by-minute account of the Columbine High School shooting, exploring how the attack unfolded, the actions of the shooters, the responses of students, teachers, and law enforcement, and the critical moments that defined the tragedy. This documentary examines the timeline, decisions, and chaos that made it one of the deadliest school shootings in U.S. history.

results.title: Where the Black Dog Runs
results.overview: As a rural village prepares for its final harvest festival as a luxury building development is greenlit, an ancient threat awakens and Julian must come face to face with a haunting piece of folklore.

results.title: Deep sea exploration : the last frontiers on Earth
results.original_title: Abysses, la face cachée des océans
results.overview: In the deep ocean, where darkness reigns, scientists uncover a hidden world that sustains life on Earth. From extraordinary creatures to invisible microbial processes, the abysses play a crucial role in regulating the climate and ocean balance. But as the race for deep-sea minerals intensifies, this fragile ecosystem is under threat. A breathtaking journey into the largest, and least known, environment on our planet.

results.title: The Girl From Ipanema: Astrud Gilberto, Queen of Bossa Nova
results.original_title: The Girl from Ipanema : Astrud Gilberto, reine de la bossa nova
results.overview: The Girl from Ipanema charts the progress of bossa nova (new wave), and the Brazilian singer Astrud Gilberto's musical development and rise to fame. Best of all, at the end of the documentary the mature Astrud answers the question that must surely be on every viewer's mind: Was she sick to death of singing The Girl from Ipanema?

results.title: The Fixation
results.overview: Álvaro, an accomplished photographer struggling with debt and his father’s terminal illness, reluctantly accepts an erotic photography assignment designed to recruit VIP clients. But the project takes an unexpected turn when he discovers that its star is Felipe, a famous model with whom he shares a turbulent past. Their reunion reignites a toxic relationship fueled by desire, jealousy, and obsession. As tensions escalate and increasingly dangerous situations surround the project, Álvaro must navigate the blurred lines between passion and madness while fighting to maintain his sanity—and survive.

results.title: Less Unhappy
results.overview: A gay man and a lesbian who are kicked out of the queer community for their toxicity and decide to try living as a straight couple, on the theory that straight people are dumb and therefore less miserable than smarter gay people.
